description.text:
InvenSense is headquartered in San Jose, CA and has offices in Berkeley, Boston, China, Taiwan, Korea, Japan, France, Canada, Slovakia, and Italy. We’re looking for top-notch individuals to join our global team. If you’re interested in being a part of our journey and helping us grow to become the leading provider of SoC platform solutions, we definitely want to hear from you.
Position Summary
We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Sales Operations Analyst to support our global sales organization reporting to Manager, Sales Operations. This role will focus on sales data analytics, ship and debit administration, CRM management, and reporting optimization within a fast-paced semiconductor environment.
This is a full-time position ideal for professionals who can quickly ramp up, deliver immediate value, and work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Operations, Customer Service and Marketing.
Typical Responsibilities
Sales Analytics & Reporting Support
• Support pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and design win tracking analysis.
• Provide variance analysis and actionable insights to sales leadership.
• Develop dashboards and automate recurring reports.
Ship and Debit Administration
• Ship and Debit Process POS and Claim Management
• Channel Activity Analysis and Reporting
• Train Channel Partners and TDK Organization SDP best practices
• Drive System Improvements (ex: EDI)
CRM & Data Management
• Ensure pipeline accuracy and standardized opportunity tracking.
• Support system clean-up and reporting enhancements.
• Assist in CRM reporting automation and dashboard creation.
Order Management Support
• Identify and recommend process improvements for Order Management process.
• Manage Audit and Order Review Process under guidance of Director, Customer Service
• Additional overflow reporting support as required
Forecasting & Planning Support
• Support demand forecasting regionally in coordination with Sales, Finance, and Sales Operations team
• Maintain CRM data integrity (e.g., Salesforce).
Process & Operational Support
• Assist with ad hoc analysis for MEMS BG team.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or related field.
• 3-5 years of experience in Sales Operations or related.
• Experience in semiconductor, electronics, or high-tech industry preferred.
• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, financial modeling).
• Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred).
• Strong analytical and communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and deliver results in a contract environment.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience working with semiconductor distribution channels.
• Knowledge of ERP systems (Oracle).
• Familiarity with BI tools (Incorta)
• Familiarity with Ship and Debit Channel Management programs
• Experience supporting global sales organizations.
